Kwikset 138 Universal Door Drilling Kit

The Kwikset 138 door lock installation kit is a professional all in one quick boring jig system. Drills 2-1/8" and 1-1/2" door prep in wood, fiberglass or metal doors. Tool free backset adjustment for drilling 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.

Kit Includes:

  • Heavy-duty black kit box
  • Quick Drill Bit Adapter
  • 1" heavy-duty DEWALT spade bit
  • Aluminum template measuring guide
  • Mortise tools with square and round corner replaceable blades
  • 2-1/8" multi-spur bit for wood doors
  • In-line arm for wood doors
  • 2-1/8" hole saw for metal and fiberglass doors
  • 1-1/2" adapter ring
  • Depth stop guide
  • Strike locater
  • In-line arm for metal and fiberglass doors
  • 1-1/2" multi-spur bit
